dtldesc: Set in one of western Mumbais well-connected residential pockets, this 3 BHK apartment in Kalpataru Estate, Poonam Nagar offers a practical combination of livability, connectivity, and township-style comfort.Property SpecificationsThis is a 3 BHK resale apartment located in the Kalpataru Estate project by Kalpataru Ltd. Positioned on the 7th floor of a 15-storey tower, the apartment benefits from balanced elevation, good airflow, and natural light.The configuration includes three bedrooms, a living and dining area, a functional kitchen space, and well-distributed internal planning that maximises usable space. The unit is semi-furnished, allowing essential fittings to support immediate occupancy while still giving scope for personal interior upgrades. The society provides round-the-clock security, intercom and controlled entry systems, ensuring a safe living environment. The presence of green zones and open spaces within the development adds to the overall residential comfort, especially in a dense urban location like Mumbai.LocalityLocated in Poonam Nagar, Jogeshwari East, the property enjoys strong connectivity across Mumbai. Major employment hubs such as SEEPZ, MIDC, and Andheri business districts are nearby, making it a convenient choice for working professionals.
